WE HAVE SPACES IN ALL YEAR GROUPS
BOOK YOUR "SCHOOL IN ACTION" TOUR NOW TO SEE WHAT OUR AMAZING SCHOOL HAS TO OFFER
CALL US ON 01285 821 463
We believe the best way to see how our school runs is to come and visit us. Doing so allows you to see the school running on a day-to-day basis. Your 'School in Action' tour will allow you the time to look at our fantastic school and what we have to offer as well as giving you the opportunity to ask any questions you may have.
If you would like to book a 'School in Action' tour, please email us via admin@miserden.gloucs.sch.uk or call on 01285 821 463 and a member of our school team will be happy to assist you.
There's nothing like first-hand experience to give you the insight you need when choosing your child's school.
A message from our Head Teacher
Miserden C of E Primary School is a small rural school based in the beautiful Miserden Village in Gloucestershire.
We build our school family on Christian values, believing that the relationship between pupils, families and staff is of the upmost importance.
Our school vision ensures that we see the prominence and strengths in all, working together to create a strong school community in which all can flourish.
We pride ourselves on delivering a high quality curriculum with high expectations for each pupil to individually thrive. The wonderful surroundings of our school enable us to fully embrace the outdoors and allow us to extend our learning environment to the wider natural space.
Miserden school is a special place with a wonderful family feel. I consider myself very fortunate to lead such a fun and nurturing environment full of happy children. But don't take my word for it, throughout our website you will find our children's view and comments.
"Encourage one another and build each other up." — 1 Thessalonians 5:11
Together we thrive
A rich learning environment where individuals are valued and flourish
